verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance documents webhooks for real-time event notifications that remove the need for polling, and lists a 'Transaction notifications' product. Its OBWMS webhook management service is described in future tense ('will provide'), which suggests event-subscription management is still maturing. missing for 10: evidence that webhooks are signed/verifiable, documented balance-update and connection-state-change event types, delivery/retry details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, data changes arrive as signed webhooks — new transactions, balance updates, connection state changes — so my system stays current without polling

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when specific events occur, eliminating the need for constant polling.
OBWMS will provide a comprehensive API for managing real-time event notifications, enabling you to subscribe to specific events, ensuring you only receive relevant updates.
